# GR03-default-mode-edit: Decides Grok autoedit (fixture-gated; SYNTHESIZED, so it stays unsupported). What Grok does with an edit when no posture approves edits: session/new with the ask posture, the edit asks, and the only grants beyond once are "Allow all edits this session" and "Enable always-approve mode": answers to an edit already asked, each widening the session from inside it, never an edits-only posture Dim Factory could set before the turn. The study rejects it (as the adapter would; nothing is written). Dim Factory itself never starts an autoedit pass on Grok: the adapter refuses it before spawning (expected events).
# Decides Grok autoedit. Record the options Grok offers for the edit and what each is called; the study rejects it. Autoedit becomes supportable only if Grok offers an edits-only posture Dim Factory can set before the turn.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.grok.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor grok --grok-home "<fixture GROK_HOME>" --bin "<the grok executable>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/grok/acp/GR03-default-mode-edit --id GR03 --slug default-mode-edit --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR03-default-mode-edit/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR03-default-mode-edit/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR03-default-mode-edit/responders.mjs --timeout 900000 -- agent --no-leader stdio
